t: What he told Aisha while they were looking at the moon
a: اسْتَعِيذِي بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا فَإِنَّ هَذَا الْغَاسِقُ إِذَا وَقَبَ
p: Istaʿīdhī bi-Llāhi min sharri hādhā, fa-inna hādha-l-ghāsiqu idhā waqab
m: Seek refuge with Allah from the evil of this, for this is the darkness as it settles.
